services.desc: One part Rhode Island getaway, one part Palm Springs pool party!Meet our vintage 35 foot lobster boat that was thoughtfully retrofitted with convenience and comfort in mind. Captain Lauren Walsh greets guests with confidence and mirth that only a life living on the water can produce. Lauren delivers an experience that is fresh and ‘locals only.’ After a cruise around the harbor that allows you to get a sense of place, its meaning, and its history, Captain Lauren suggests you hold on to your hat as she pushes the throttle forward.
